sources_and_terminal_log.network_scope: Actual loaded files.network; no source-network substitution

actual_commands.scope: Actual CSV times and full mapped rows; no green/offset inferred from warmup JSON

actual_vsl_apply_readbacks.vsl_scope: DesSpeedDistr class reference ID, not observed vehicle speed; sequential per-class reads, not atomic four-class snapshot.

actual_initial_and_changed_writes.scope: Each initial application and command-clock state change needs an actual immediate row; unchanged setter skips are allowed

native_lsa.limitation: LSA has no pre/post stage. Matching timestamps/states cannot prove stage order or unseen holds.
